name: Time Secret
source:
You needed to discover the weakness of alien "Danak" race in order to save the colonial planet "Farras" in 2552 AD.

[From [url=http://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/04/vn-of-year-1984.html]vndbreview[/url]]

2552年，为了拯救地球的殖民星“法拉斯”，你必须查明外星种族“达纳克人”的弱点。
